feature: Offline destination threat-list checks and explicit local public-list updates

interfaces.mcp: check_connection_destinations() without arguments; strict anonymous projection, readOnlyHint=true, openWorldHint=false; no updater tool
interfaces.dashboard: Historical destination state counts, publication/retrieval/check/expiry and source attribution; warning notice and opt-in local connection evidence; never added to severity findings

privacy.mcp: No IPs/ports, process names/PIDs/start times, CIDRs, reference IDs, paths, file hashes or raw errors; older disclosure settings do not enable identifiers
privacy.history: Allowlisted anonymous summary; real details require separate owner settings and are never saved by MCP; errors use a fixed message
privacy.test_stores: Explicit temporary paths; resolving personal default during cache tests fails
privacy.updater: Fixed HTTPS GETs only; no ambient proxy or credentials; provider sees updater public source IP and timing

cache.platform: POSIX only; Windows read/update fail closed
cache.permissions: 0700 folders / 0600 files, pinned descriptors, local-filesystem validation, no-follow regular owned single-link files
cache.reader: Pins a single atomic bundle; no folder, lock file or cache writes
cache.writer: Separate-process lock, 30-second total budget, bounded TLS fetches, minimum one-hour attempt interval, atomic v4/v6 publication and last-valid previous generation
cache.limits: 4 MiB per feed, 50000 raw entries per family, 12 MiB bundle, 32 MiB managed store
cache.failure: Old current retained on validation/fetch/cancel/capacity failure; no fallback to old generations on corrupt current read
cache.timestamps: Provider publication is freshness basis; expiry at equality; reject publication rollback; successful download cannot refresh stale publication dates
cache.representation: Original feed bytes base64-encoded with SHA-256 in one bundle; index validated/rebuilt in memory. Hashes are integrity checks, not publisher signatures.
cache.dependencies: Only standard-library imports added; no lock, SBOM or software license changes needed; public datasets not bundled
